title: Reversal of a Paid Rental Month in Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
Claims adjustment manual - Durable Medical Equipment Rentals rental ledger.

**Rule.** A reversal withdraws exactly one paid rental month, identified by its own record, for a stated reversal reason (paid during an inpatient stay, paid after the cap, paid after return, duplicate), and that month stops counting toward the cap. A paid rental month is reversed at most once.

## Effect of a reversal

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Months | One rental month is withdrawn from the placement's paid rental months |
| Amounts | The allowed amount and the patient's cost share of that month are withdrawn |
| Which month | The paid rental month named by its own ledger record |
| Reason | One stated reason: paid during an inpatient stay, paid after the cap, paid after return, or duplicate |
| Cap | The reversed month no longer counts toward the cap |

## The at-most-once condition

- **Condition:** a paid rental month is reversed at most once.
- **Evidence:** the company's rental ledger, read before the reversal is booked; the paid month's own record is the object, and an existing reversal already recorded against that same record means the condition is not met.
- **Correlation:** each reversal is tied to the one paid rental month it names; a reversal of another paid month does not affect it.

## Hypothetical cases

| Rental ledger before the reversal (hypothetical) | Reversal sought | Under the rule |
|---|---|---|
| Rental month 7 paid; no reversal against it | Reverse month 7, reason duplicate | One month withdrawn; month 7 stops counting toward the cap |
| Rental month 7 paid and already reversed once | Reverse month 7 again | Not met: a paid month is reversed at most once |
| Rental months 7 and 8 paid; month 7 already reversed | Reverse month 8, reason paid after return | One month withdrawn: month 8 has not been reversed |

**Count illustration (hypothetical).** A placement with 13 paid rental months, one of which is then reversed as paid after the cap, has 12 paid rental months counting toward the cap.
